"""Exact/validated450-variable reduction of the source imaginary left-null system.

Matrix arguments use a common FLINT fmpq_mat or arb_mat backend. The inverse
is DEFINED from an actual selected master minor. No approximate left inverse
or orthogonal-projector assumption is accepted.
"""


def _matrix_like(reference,rows,cols,entries=None):
    cls=type(reference)
    return cls(rows,cols) if entries is None else cls(rows,cols,entries)


def _identity(reference,size):
    return _matrix_like(reference,size,size,[int(i==j) for i in range(size) for j in range(size)])


def _columns(matrix,start,stop):
    return _matrix_like(matrix,matrix.nrows(),stop-start,
        [matrix[i,j] for i in range(matrix.nrows()) for j in range(start,stop)])


class ImaginaryRankResidual:
    """Construct the COMPLETE residual map from untransformed J columns.

    master_blocks[j] is50×19 with column order even2..18, odd1..19.
    T is the exact sine matrix. selector_rows[j] selects19 monomial rows;
    source choice0..18 corresponds to powers1..19. All50 transformed
    membership rows are retained, including19 algebraically exact zeros.
    """
    def __init__(self,master_blocks,T,even_count,selector_rows=None,selector_row_powers=None,progress=None):
        self.J=list(master_blocks);self.T=T;self.M=T.nrows();self.e=int(even_count)
        if T.ncols()!=self.M or len(self.J)!=self.M:raise ValueError('Square phase matrix and one master block per source node required')
        if not self.J:raise ValueError('Nonempty master blocks required')
        self.r=self.J[0].ncols();self.o=self.r-self.e
        if not 0<self.e<self.r<=self.M:raise ValueError('Nonempty even/odd columns with independent local capacity required')
        if any(type(J)!=type(T) or J.nrows()!=self.M or J.ncols()!=self.r for J in self.J):
            raise ValueError('All master blocks must have matching backend and dimensions')
        self.selectors=([list(range(self.r)) for _ in self.J] if selector_rows is None else [list(v) for v in selector_rows])
        self.powers=([[0]*self.r for _ in self.J] if selector_row_powers is None else [list(v) for v in selector_row_powers])
        if len(self.selectors)!=self.M or len(self.powers)!=self.M:raise ValueError('One selector/scaling record per node required')
        for rows,powers in zip(self.selectors,self.powers):
            if len(rows)!=self.r or len(set(rows))!=self.r or any(not isinstance(i,int) or not 0<=i<self.M for i in rows):
                raise ValueError('Every selector must contain exactlyr distinct valid monomial rows')
            if len(powers)!=self.r or any(not isinstance(i,int) for i in powers):raise ValueError('Integer dyadic row exponents required')
        self.TT=T.transpose();self.TinvT=self.TT.inv();self.A=[];self.E=[];self.O=[]
        self.membership=[];self.signed=[];self.inverse_checks=[]
        eye=_identity(T,self.M);zero=T[0,0]*0;one=zero+1
        for node,(J,rows,powers) in enumerate(zip(self.J,self.selectors,self.powers)):
            # D is exactdyadic. A=(D S J)^-1 D S has the same exact left
            # inverse definition as(SJ)^-1S; D only conditions this inversion.
            scales=[one*(1<<p) if p>=0 else one/(1<<(-p)) for p in powers]
            minor=_matrix_like(T,self.r,self.r,[scales[i]*J[row,k] for i,row in enumerate(rows) for k in range(self.r)])
            inverse=minor.inv() # fmpq exact; Arb defaultvalidated, neverapprox.
            A=_matrix_like(T,self.r,self.M)
            for i in range(self.r):
                for k,row in enumerate(rows):A[i,row]=inverse[i,k]*scales[k]
            check=A*J
            good=all((check[i,k].contains(int(i==k)) if hasattr(check[i,k],'contains') else check[i,k]==int(i==k))
                for i in range(self.r) for k in range(self.r))
            if not good:raise ArithmeticError('Local inverse product sanity check failed')
            W=self.TinvT*J;E=_columns(W,0,self.e);O=_columns(W,self.e,self.r)
            membership=(eye-J*A)*self.TT
            # These rows vanish by S(I−J(SJ)^-1S)=0. They are exact
            # identities, not rounded residuals selected by a threshold.
            for row in rows:
                for k in range(self.M):membership[row,k]=zero
            signedW=_matrix_like(T,self.M,self.r,
                [W[i,k] if k<self.e else -W[i,k] for i in range(self.M) for k in range(self.r)])
            signed=signedW*A*self.TT
            self.A.append(A);self.E.append(E);self.O.append(O);self.membership.append(membership);self.signed.append(signed)
            self.inverse_checks.append(dict(node=node,selector_rows=rows,dyadic_row_powers=powers,
                inverse_defined_from_selected_minor=True,product_identity_enclosed_or_exact=True))
            if progress is not None:
                progress(node,self,dict(minor=minor,inverse=inverse,row_scales=scales))
        self.sym_pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(self.M) for j in range(i,self.M)]
        self.columns=self.M*self.e;self.rows=self.M*self.M+len(self.sym_pairs)
        self.exact_zero_rows=[j*self.M+i for j,rows in enumerate(self.selectors) for i in rows]
        self.metadata=dict(source_node_count=self.M,even_dimension=self.e,odd_dimension=self.o,
            unknown_count=self.columns,full_residual_row_count=self.rows,
            exactly_zero_membership_rows=self.exact_zero_rows,active_row_count=self.rows-len(self.exact_zero_rows),
            membership='(I−J_j A_j) T^T P^T[:,j], retaining allM rows',
            left_inverse='A_j=(D_j S_j J_j)^−1 D_j S_j; L_j=A_j T^T, hence L_j(T^−T J_j)=I',
            symmetry='Uppertriangle entries ofSym(Q−R), unweighted; offdiagonals include1/2, notsqrt2',
            transpose='Ordinary transpose in original congruence P/Q/R coordinates',
            variable_order='node-major even weights; alpha[j*even_dimension+a]',
            approximate_left_inverse_used_as_model=False,numerical_rank_truncation=False)

    def row(self,index):
        """Assemble one exact/enclosed row without constructing the whole map."""
        if not isinstance(index,int) or not 0<=index<self.rows:raise ValueError('Residual row index out of range')
        if index<self.M*self.M:
            node,component=divmod(index,self.M)
            return [self.membership[node][component,k]*self.E[k][node,a]
                    for k in range(self.M) for a in range(self.e)]
        i,j=self.sym_pairs[index-self.M*self.M]
        if i==j:
            return [-3*self.signed[j][j,k]*self.E[k][j,a]
                    for k in range(self.M) for a in range(self.e)]
        return [-3*(self.signed[j][i,k]*self.E[k][j,a]+self.signed[i][j,k]*self.E[k][i,a])/2
                for k in range(self.M) for a in range(self.e)]

    def matrix(self,row_indices=None):
        """Materialize requested rows; selecting a minor never changes fullmap."""
        indices=list(range(self.rows)) if row_indices is None else list(row_indices)
        return _matrix_like(self.T,len(indices),self.columns,[v for i in indices for v in self.row(i)])

    def recover(self,alpha):
        """Recover P,Q,R and every full residual for one candidate alpha."""
        if alpha.nrows()!=self.columns or alpha.ncols()!=1 or type(alpha)!=type(self.T):
            raise ValueError('A matching backend column of all even weights is required')
        P=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M);Q=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M);R=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M)
        residual=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M);weights=[];zero=self.T[0,0]*0
        for j in range(self.M):
            a=_matrix_like(self.T,self.e,1,[alpha[j*self.e+k,0] for k in range(self.e)])
            column=self.E[j]*a
            for i in range(self.M):P[i,j]=column[i,0]
        for j in range(self.M):
            t=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,1,[P[j,i] for i in range(self.M)])
            z=self.A[j]*self.TT*t
            even=_matrix_like(self.T,self.e,1,[-3*z[k,0] for k in range(self.e)])
            odd=_matrix_like(self.T,self.o,1,[-3*z[self.e+k,0] for k in range(self.o)])
            qc=self.E[j]*even;rc=self.O[j]*odd;res=self.membership[j]*t
            for i in range(self.M):Q[i,j]=qc[i,0];R[i,j]=rc[i,0];residual[i,j]=res[i,0]
            for i in self.selectors[j]:residual[i,j]=zero
            weights.append((even,odd))
        S=(Q-R+(Q-R).transpose())/2
        vector=_matrix_like(self.T,self.rows,1,
            [residual[i,j] for j in range(self.M) for i in range(self.M)]+[S[i,j] for i,j in self.sym_pairs])
        return dict(P=P,Q=Q,R=R,membership=residual,symmetry=S,residual_vector=vector,recovered_weights=weights)

"""Validated universal K moments and full-column fixed-energy source rows.

All derivatives/spins are generated algebraically from one K pool. No physical
coefficient, spin, or numerical rank direction is truncated. The enclosing
export precision is explicit and checked by ball containment.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F
import time

from .partial_wave_master_prototype import elementary_K0,reconstruct_moments,assemble_isospin_row
from .rational_partial_wave import normalized_rational_geometry


def ball_fraction(value):
    from flint import arb
    value=F(value)
    return arb(value.numerator)/value.denominator


def scalar_record(value):
    if not value.is_finite():raise ArithmeticError('Nonfinite interval')
    return dict(ball=value.str(35),lower_rational=str(value.lower().fmpq()),upper_rational=str(value.upper().fmpq()))


def positive_integer_power(value,n):
    result=value*0+1
    while n:
        if n&1:result*=value
        n//=2
        if n:value*=value
    return result


def evaluate_K_family(s,k,degree,max_spin,*,tolerance_digits,deadline=None,progress=None):
    """Compute elementary K0 and integrate K1 for r=-2*max_spin..degree.

    The caller fixes Arb precision. Each integral is attempted once. A work
    limit or nonfinite return raises ValueError instead of fabricating a pool.
    Finite integrals remain valid if their global requested radius is missed.
    The caller derives k=(sqrt(s)-2)/(sqrt(s)+2) from the same exact real
    energy. The two open domains s>4 and 0<s<4 have the same meromorphic
    rational geometry; zero/threshold endpoints are excluded.
    """
    from flint import arb,acb
    physical=s>4 and 0<k<1
    subthreshold=0<s<4 and -1<k<0
    if degree<1 or max_spin<0 or not (physical or subthreshold):
        raise ValueError('Valid degree/spin and matching open physical or subthreshold energy/k domains required')
    lower=1-k;log_lower=lower.log();tol=ball_fraction(F(1,10**tolerance_digits))
    K0={};K1={};records=[];counts=dict(evaluations=0,analytic_calls=0,pole_rejections=0)
    kc=acb(k);kc_lower=acb(lower)
    for r in range(-2*max_spin,degree+1):
        if deadline is not None and time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise ValueError('Whole-worker deadline reached')
        first=arb(1)/2 if r==0 else elementary_K0(r,s,lower,log_lower)
        if not first.is_finite():raise ValueError('Nonfinite elementary first K moment')
        start=time.monotonic();before=dict(counts)
        def callback(t,analytic):
            counts['evaluations']+=1;counts['analytic_calls']+=int(analytic)
            if deadline is not None and time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise ValueError('Whole-worker callback deadline reached')
            geometry=normalized_rational_geometry(t,kc)
            if geometry is None:
                counts['pole_rejections']+=1;return acb('nan')
            pref,_,_,Y=geometry;kt=kc*t
            u=kc_lower*(1+kt*kt)/(kc_lower+(1+kc)*kt)
            if r<0 and u.contains(0):
                counts['pole_rejections']+=1;return acb('nan')
            power=positive_integer_power(1/u,-r) if r<0 else positive_integer_power(u,r)
            return pref*Y*power
        result=acb.integral(callback,0,1,abs_tol=tol,rel_tol=tol,deg_limit=1400,
            eval_limit=1000000,depth_limit=4096,use_heap=True)
        if not result.is_finite():raise ValueError('Nonfinite K1 enclosure at r='+str(r))
        if not result.imag.contains(0):raise ArithmeticError('Real-contour K1 does not enclose realness')
        # K1 is exactly real by its defining real-contour integral.
        second=result.real;goal=max(tol,tol*result.abs_lower())
        K0[r]=first;K1[r]=second
        record=dict(r=r,K0=scalar_record(first),K1=scalar_record(second),
            complex_global_radius=scalar_record(result.rad()),
            requested_global_goal_met=bool(result.rad()<=goal.lower()),
            counts={name:counts[name]-before[name] for name in counts},elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
        records.append(record)
        if progress is not None:progress(len(records),len(range(-2*max_spin,degree+1)),counts)
    return K0,K1,dict(records=records,counts=counts,integral_count=len(records),
        all_complex_goals_met=all(r['requested_global_goal_met'] for r in records),
        backend_convergence_status_available=False,quadrature_retries=0)


def shifted_binomial_moments(pool,degree,max_spin):
    """Exact forward differences: integral u^-a (u-1)^n, retaining every n."""
    output=[]
    for a in range(2*max_spin+1):
        work=[pool[b-a] for b in range(degree+1)];values=[]
        for n in range(degree+1):
            values.append(work[0])
            work=[work[j+1]-work[j] for j in range(len(work)-1)]
        output.append(values)
    return output


def legendre_laurent_rows(s,max_spin):
    """Coefficient row for u^0,u^-1,... in P_l(1+32/d*(u^-1-u^-2))."""
    zero=s*0;one=zero+1;T=32/(s-4);mu=[one,T,-T]
    rows=[[one]]
    if not max_spin:return rows
    rows.append(mu)
    for ell in range(1,max_spin):
        product=[zero]*(len(rows[-1])+2)
        for i,a in enumerate(mu):
            for j,b in enumerate(rows[-1]):product[i+j]+=a*b
        following=[(2*ell+1)*v/(ell+1) for v in product]
        for i,value in enumerate(rows[-2]):following[i]-=ell*value/(ell+1)
        rows.append(following)
    return rows


def source_rows_from_K(K0,K1,s,phase_powers,degree,max_spin):
    """Yield (I,ell,row,border diagnostics) for every allowed source wave."""
    from flint import arb,acb
    first=shifted_binomial_moments(K0,degree,max_spin)
    second=shifted_binomial_moments(K1,degree,max_spin)
    laurent=legendre_laurent_rows(s,max_spin)
    for ell,coefficients in enumerate(laurent):
        J=[sum((v*first[a][n] for a,v in enumerate(coefficients)),arb(0)) for n in range(1,degree+1)]
        H=[sum((v*second[a][n] for a,v in enumerate(coefficients)),arb(0)) for n in range(1,degree+1)]
        if ell%2 and not H[0].contains(0):raise ArithmeticError('Universal K odd H1 failed the exact parity identity')
        matrix=reconstruct_moments(J,H,s,ell)
        border_radius=maximum_exact([v.rad() for v in J+H])
        moment_radius=maximum_exact([v.rad() for row in matrix for v in row])
        metadata=dict(maximum_border_radius=scalar_record(border_radius),
                      maximum_moment_radius=scalar_record(moment_radius),
                      odd_diagonal_exact=bool(ell%2))
        for I in ([0,2] if ell%2==0 else [1]):
            row=assemble_isospin_row(matrix,phase_powers[1],degree,ell,I,phase_powers=phase_powers)
            yield I,ell,[v if isinstance(v,acb) else acb(v) for v in row],metadata


def maximum_exact(values):
    """Maximum of exact Arb numbers, without Float64 underflow in a key."""
    from flint import arb
    largest=arb(0)
    for value in values:
        if not value.is_exact() or not value.is_finite():raise ValueError('Exact finite Arb comparison values required')
        if value>largest:largest=value
    return largest


def component_accuracy(values):
    from flint import arb
    values=list(values)
    maximum_radius=maximum_exact(v.rad() for v in values)
    maximum_midpoint=maximum_exact(abs(v.mid()) for v in values)
    exact_zero_count=sum(v.is_zero() for v in values)
    all_zero=exact_zero_count==len(values)
    ratio=(arb(0) if all_zero else (maximum_radius/maximum_midpoint if maximum_midpoint>0 else None))
    return dict(maximum_absolute_radius=scalar_record(maximum_radius),
        maximum_absolute_midpoint=scalar_record(maximum_midpoint),
        max_radius_over_max_midpoint=None if ratio is None else scalar_record(ratio),
        exact_zero_entry_count=exact_zero_count,all_entries_exactly_zero=all_zero,
        midpoint_scale_resolved=bool(maximum_midpoint>0 or all_zero),
        absolute_1e_minus_80_goal_met=bool(maximum_radius<ball_fraction(F(1,10**80))))


def encode_real_ball(value):
    """Exact dyadic midpoint/radius pairs; null means an exact zero."""
    if value.is_zero():return None
    if not value.is_finite():raise ValueError('A finite ball is required')
    m,e=value.mid().man_exp();r,re=value.rad().man_exp()
    return [[hex(int(m)),int(e)],[hex(int(r)),int(re)]]


def decode_real_ball(record):
    from flint import arb
    if record is None:return arb(0)
    return arb((int(record[0][0],16),record[0][1]),(int(record[1][0],16),record[1][1]))


def enclosing_export_row(row,export_bits):
    """Round outward, verify containment, encode and report radius inflation."""
    from flint import arb,ctx
    if not isinstance(export_bits,int) or not 64<=export_bits<=ctx.prec:
        raise ValueError('Export precision must be64..working precision bits')
    working=ctx.prec;original_re=[v.real for v in row];original_im=[v.imag for v in row]
    try:
        ctx.prec=export_bits
        re=[+v for v in original_re];im=[+v for v in original_im]
        assert all(b.contains(a) for a,b in zip(original_re+original_im,re+im))
        encoded=[[encode_real_ball(a),encode_real_ball(b)] for a,b in zip(re,im)]
    finally:ctx.prec=working
    inflation=maximum_exact([(b.rad()-a.rad()).upper() for a,b in zip(original_re+original_im,re+im)])
    return encoded,dict(export_precision_bits=export_bits,all_export_balls_contain_working_balls=True,
        maximum_radius_increase=scalar_record(inflation),
        working_real=component_accuracy(original_re),working_imaginary=component_accuracy(original_im),
        exported_real=component_accuracy(re),exported_imaginary=component_accuracy(im))
